description.value: Creekside Coffee Factory is a coffee-focused café in the Lower Mainland & Fraser Valley region of BC. The OSM record notes outdoor seating, suggesting a relaxed stop with some open-air space. It sits along a route accessible to touring cyclists looking for a caffeine fix in the Fraser Valley.
